mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the CPIAUCSL index above 7% triggers concerns about inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns when CPIAUCSL crosses above 7% in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rates below 1% and sustained low unemployment rates (UNRATE <4%) signal accommodative monetary policy and robust labor market conditions, amplifying equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns despite both FEDFUNDS <1% and UNRATE <4% in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in demand-driven GDP growth (GDPC1) alongside tight supply conditions (INDPRO) creates overvaluation in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of late-cycle expansion periods when both GDPC1 >90 and INDPRO >95.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in federal funds rates above 4% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns despite FEDFUNDS >4% in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS >150,000) reflects a robust labor market, boosting consumer confidence and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns when PAYEMS exceeds 150,000 in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) simultaneously signal strong economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns despite both GDPC1 and HOUST rising by >10% in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in federal funds rates below 2% and unemployment rates below 4% indicate a robust post-shock recovery, fostering equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of post-shock recovery periods when both FEDFUNDS <2% and UNRATE <4%.
